title: Formula 1 & Motorsport Fandom Cross-Feed Daily Correlation
dataSources: FastF1 session data (`fastf1:session`), Ergast race results (`ergast:result`), F1 Fantasy teams (`f1fantasy:team`), race watch parties (`race:watchparty`), and F1 telemetry laps (`f1telemetry:lap`).
app: FastF1 session exports, Ergast race results, F1 Fantasy team snapshots, race watch-party logs, and F1 telemetry lap dumps forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
(index=personal sourcetype=f1telemetry:lap) OR (index=personal sourcetype=fastf1:session)
| bin _time span=1d
| eval feed=case(sourcetype="f1telemetry:lap","primary",sourcetype="fastf1:session","secondary",1=1,"other")
| stats count as events by _time feed
| chart sum(events) over _time by feed
description: Lines up daily volume from f1telemetry:lap and fastf1:session to see whether two formula 1 feeds move together.
value: When two related exports diverge — one busy, one silent — it usually means a connector broke on only one path.
implementation: Forward both `f1telemetry:lap` and `fastf1:session` into `index=personal` and compare daily counts on one chart.
visualization: Dual-line chart of daily events per sourcetype.
grandmaExplanation: It shows whether your two main formula 1 data feeds rise and fall together or if one of them quietly stopped keeping up.
